name: NiSource
description: NiSource is a regulated gas-and-electric utility holding company serving about 3.8 million customers in six states: natural gas distribution through the Columbia Gas companies (about 2.4 million customers in Ohio, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Kentucky and Maryland) and, in northern Indiana, NIPSCO (about 0.9 million gas customers and 0.5 million electric customers). About two-thirds of revenue is gas and one-third electric (computed), but its growth story is electric: NIPSCO is replacing coal by 2028 and, through a generation subsidiary (GenCo, 19.9% sold to Blackstone), is building gas plants to serve contracted Amazon and Alphabet data centers. State regulators set rates to recover cost plus an allowed return (about 9.6% to 10.0% ROE in recent orders).

That list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 4931 (Electric & Other Services Combined) per EDGAR.
